title: Pre-Crawl Prioritization and Seed Classification for Large-Scale Web Archiving
abstract: arXiv:2611.27743v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Pre-crawl prioritization systems decide which pages to fetch first before indexing, aiming to improve crawl efficiency and coverage. Existing approaches based on page popularity and relevance are unsuited to web-archival crawlers that prioritize comprehensive coverage over selective retrieval. We explore prioritization techniques tailored to web archival operations using URL lexical analysis, dynamic domain reputation systems, and HTTP response analysis to inform crawl scheduling decisions. By incorporating predictive models that estimate content change and disappearance probabilities, we improve crawl completeness while reducing redundant visits to stable resources. Through large-scale experiments, we demonstrate that our methods improve archival effectiveness and resource utilization compared to undirected crawling.

translated_title: 面向大规模网络归档的爬取前优先级排序与种子分类
translated_abstract: 爬取前优先级排序系统在索引之前决定优先抓取哪些页面，旨在提高爬取效率和覆盖率。现有基于页面流行度和相关性的方法不适用于优先追求全面覆盖而非选择性检索的网络归档爬虫。我们探索了专为网络归档操作定制的优先级排序技术，利用URL词法分析、动态域名信誉系统和HTTP响应分析来为爬取调度决策提供依据。通过引入能够预测内容变化和消失概率的模型，我们在提高爬取完整性的同时减少了对稳定资源的冗余访问。通过大规模实验，我们证明了与无方向性爬取相比，我们的方法提高了归档效果和资源利用率。
tldr: 该论文提出了面向大规模网络归档的爬取前优先级排序技术，结合URL词法分析、动态域名信誉、HTTP响应分析以及内容变化与消失概率预测模型，在提升归档完整性的同时有效减少冗余访问并提高资源利用率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes pre-crawl prioritization techniques for large-scale web archiving, combining URL lexical analysis, dynamic domain reputation systems, HTTP response analysis, and predictive models for content change and disappearance to improve archival completeness while reducing redundant visits and enhancing resource utilization.
